Reminds me of my dad’s Uncle’s Son
🎥🎬: Fightland

In Fightland, the road to boxing glory is filled with more than brutal competition. Rising fighters enter a world where promoters, money, reputation, and powerful connections can matter just as much as talent. With careers hanging in the balance, every victory creates new opportunities—and new enemies.

Behind the fights are personal struggles, dangerous rivalries, and difficult choices that test everyone’s loyalty. As the stakes climb, the pursuit of becoming a champion threatens to consume the very people willing to risk everything for their shot at the top.

Fightland is here — new series streaming now on @STARZ.

source_details.synopsis: Fightland is a boxing crime drama television series created by Daniel Fajemisin-Duncan, Marlon Smith, Damione Macedon and Raphael Jackson Jr.. It premiered on July 31, 2026, on Starz in the United States and August 27, 2026, on Sky Atlantic in the United Kingdom.
